title: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B — full-logit contrast, source-I/O profile, persistent-state multi-token decoding
author: LLM Bridge
scope: A controlled contrasting-input full-logit comparison, an exact per-token source-read profile, and genuine persistent-state multi-token generation on the real model. Full-model numerical reference parity is still NOT established (no resident reference runnable).

git.head: d583438

commits_this_round.summary: feat(model): source-I/O profile + persistent-state multi-token generation
test(hybrid): persistent-state split-call equivalence for multi-token decode
test(state): deeper multi-token persistence + EOS termination in generate
test(model): real-weight numerical parity for Q5_K and IQ4_NL (gated)

git.execution_provenance: the two-token run executed from the test binary llmbridge_core-777d8b773c built at launch (~commit d583438, before 96e4523 added the EOS early-stop); the EOS change is immaterial to this non-EOS run. Results below are from that binary.

prompts.tokenizer: exact official parity established previously (20/20); ids below are reference-verified
prompts.note: step 2's input is the step-1 generated token under advanced recurrent state and position -- a DIFFERENT autoregressive context, NOT a same-position isolated-input test.

source_io_profile_per_token.method: computed from the tensor table (sizes only; no weight payload read). Each single-token forward reads every recurrent/attention/MoE-non-expert tensor in full, only n_expert_used/n_expert (22/512) of each packed expert tensor, one embedding row, and the output projection once.
top_three_latency_causes: raw disk bandwidth: ~7.6 GiB must be moved per token at ~10 MiB/s on the external G: drive
MoE non-expert (Q8_0/Q5_K/Q6_K) + sparse expert (IQ2_XXS/IQ4_NL) reads (~3.8 GiB/token combined)
source_io_profile_per_token.conclusion: First-token latency is disk-bandwidth-bound: 7736 MiB/token / ~10 MiB/s ~= 770 s, matching the measured 769.7 s.

io_optimization.read_coalescing: NOT implemented — measurements do not justify it. Each tensor is read exactly once per token in ~64 KiB sequential chunks; coalescing cannot reduce the 7.6 GiB byte volume, and the ~10 MiB/s rate indicates disk bandwidth, not per-read syscall overhead.
io_optimization.verified_cache: NOT implemented — there are no repeated reads within a token, and the cross-token working set (7.6 GiB) vastly exceeds any bounded (<=64 MiB) cache admissible within ~2 GiB free RAM; the OS page cache cannot hold it either. A cache would not reduce reads for this model on this host.
io_optimization.honest_position: Per the brief, no speculative optimization was added and no speedup invented. The real remedies are faster storage (SSD/NVMe) or enough RAM to hold the hot weights; both are out of scope and out of host budget. Authentication and bounded range reads are unchanged.
io_optimization.acceptance_B_C: Reported as measurement-justified NO-OP: coalescing/cache are not warranted for a 7.6 GiB/token working set on this host; no security contract was touched.

full_logit_contrast.method: persistent-state generate('Hi', n_new=2): step 1 input = prompt token 37133; step 2 input = the step-1 generated token under advanced state/position. Compact per-step diagnostics (top-20, logit-vector L2 NORM, max-abs, non-finite) captured without changing model math. Full logit vectors were NOT retained, so only top-20-scope and per-vector norms are compared (no full-vocab pairwise L2 / cosine).
full_logit_contrast.conclusion: The output distribution clearly evolves as autoregressive context advances: top-1 changes (1044 ',' -> 1032 ' '), top-20 overlap is only 2/20, max-abs drops 64.91 -> 59.15, and the logit-vector norm changes by ~915. This resolves the earlier concern -- the model is NOT stuck on token 1044; feeding 1044 back yields a different next token. This is a context-evolution result, NOT a same-position input-sensitivity experiment (that was shown separately via the embed/layer-0 L2 and the reduced-hybrid structural test).

multi_token_generation.reduced_fixture_validation: persistent_state_split_calls_equal_single_call + five_token_stepwise_equals_single_call + concurrent_sessions_are_isolated + reset_restores_fresh_state_exactly (nemotron_hybrid): split/stepwise calls equal single calls in last-position logits (max_abs < 1e-5) and position; sessions are isolated; reset == fresh. Validates persistent recurrent/KV state across call boundaries.
multi_token_generation.acceptance_A: MET -- two genuine tokens (1044, 1032) generated consecutively through ONE persistent 88-layer streamed session; token 1 fed into step 2; sequence position advanced 1 -> 2; distinct second token confirms real autoregressive feedback (not repeated independent one-token runs).
multi_token_generation.acceptance_D: MET (persistent-state multi-token decoding genuine and resource-safe; ~12 min/token, bandwidth-bound).

real_weight_numerical_parity.method: bounded streamed dequant_matvec / PackedExperts vs an independent dequantize_rows + f64 dot over the SAME real tensor bytes (reference does not call the production matvec).
real_weight_numerical_parity.acceptance_B_C: MET -- Q5_K and IQ4_NL real-weight ops match an independent reference to ~1e-9 (plus prior Q8_0 and IQ2_XXS); tensor binding, orientation, block geometry, packed offsets, and reader correctness confirmed on the actual model.

security.preserved: three-shard SHA-256 provenance, authenticated bounded range reads, SplitGgufIndex bounds, packed-expert slicing, cancellation/deadline, session isolation — all unchanged; no cache/coalescing added that could bypass verification.

remaining_limitations: full-model numerical reference parity (no resident oracle runnable on this host)
first-token latency is disk-bandwidth-bound (~7.6 GiB/token at ~10 MiB/s); no bounded in-RAM optimization helps this working set — faster storage or much more RAM is required
no interactive throughput (~13 min per generated token)
final_status: PARTIALLY COMPLETE — ACCEPTANCE A (genuine two-token persistent-state generation: 'Hi' -> 1044 ',' -> 1032 ' ') MET; ACCEPTANCE B (logit evolution measured and honestly scoped to top-20 + norms; context-evolution not input-sensitivity) MET; ACCEPTANCE C (real-weight Q5_K + IQ4_NL numerical parity to ~1e-9) MET; ACCEPTANCE D (measured I/O profile preserved, no speculative optimization) MET; ACCEPTANCE E (fmt+clippy clean, 256 non-native + 324 native tests pass, no-default builds) MET. Full-model numerical reference parity remains UNestablished (no resident oracle), and interactive performance remains blocked (~12 min/token, disk-bandwidth-bound). No fabrication; model not declared fully supported.
